settings.heading: The Leadership Imprint
settings.text: A behavioural assessment of how you lead, what happens under pressure, and how to lead the three styles you are not.

settings.heading: The Mirror
settings.text: How you think your team actually sees you. The gap between the two is where the growth is.

settings.heading: Team sessions
settings.text: Bring the Imprint to a group and see the shape of the room: what your team has too much of, and what it is missing.

settings.title: HOW YOU LEAD, MADE LEGIBLE
settings.tagline: Not how well you lead. How. And what it costs.
settings.body:
Most leadership tools tell you who you are and stop. We go one step further: we show you how your team is likely experiencing you, and what your team as a whole is missing.

It starts with a fifteen-minute assessment. It ends with something you can act on Monday morning.
